notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
Made a few small changes to the game. While there's still new stuff I'd like to add, I'm updating a few requested things now so no one has to wait up for the bigger changes. Here's what's new:

[list][*]Adjusted flashlight brightness to be more balanced between indoor and outdoor spaces. 
[*]Removed preset inputs for gamepad, should now be configurable. I don't own a controller to test this, so please do let me know if there's still an issue.
[*]Slightly shortened a few transition sequences.[/list]
